Interface Classifier

All Known Implementing Classes:
LlmClassifier
@Experimental public interface Classifier
A decision model that answers typed questions with probability distributions.

Unlike a BaseLlm, a classifier does not generate text, stream, or call tools. Implementations are stateless and safe for concurrent calls, so a request must include any context from earlier turns in its input.

    • classify

      io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single<ClassifierResponse> classify(ClassifierRequest request)
      Answers every question in request about its input, with one Answer under each question ID. Every implementation accepts ClassifierContent and text-only ClassifierInput.Content; for input its model does not support, such as images, the returned Single fails with IllegalArgumentException.
